'''Orin Mersai''' was a musician whose work had been banned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was no longer active by the time of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] covertly preserved recordings of Mersai's artistic output along with that of a number of other musicians whose work had fallen victim to Imperial censorship.
